question: What person was known for both Peston on Sunday and the Northern Rock crisis?

results.title: Robert Peston
results.text: Robert James Kenneth Peston (born 25 April 1960) is a British journalist and presenter. He is the Political Editor of ITV News and host of the weekly political discussion show "Peston on Sunday". From February 2006 until March 2014, he was the Business Editor for BBC News. He became known to a wider public with his reporting of the late-2000s financial crisis, especially with his scoop on the Northern Rock crisis.

results.title: Peston on Sunday
results.text: Peston on Sunday is the flagship political discussion programme on British television network ITV, broadcast live on Sunday mornings from 10 am and rebroadcast after the "News at Ten" on Sunday evening. The programme is presented by Robert Peston, the Political Editor of ITV News, and features discussion with politicians and public figures on the major news events of the week.

results.title: Northern Rock Foundation
results.text: Northern Rock Foundation was an independent charity and company limited by guarantee in the United Kingdom. It was formed in 1997 when the Northern Rock company was floated on the stock exchange. The foundation has continued for a number of years after the bank was nationalised, and later purchased by Virgin Money, but in April 2014 it was announced that it would be wound down after not being able to agree funding terms with Virgin. It closed in 2016.
